notes.title: Reincarnation update
notes.content:
Now you can Reincarnate
Each time you reincarnate with more than 100 million points you will earn 1 reincarnation point.
Each reincarnation point will give you +1x permanent point bonus.
You will also be placed in Reincarnation Leaderboard.

-4 new achievements added
-Kennel upgrade price increase lowered
-Bug fixes

Remember that when you Reincarnate you will lose your points and kennel upgrades.

Happy clicking!

notes.title: Major update! Non-AI content added!
notes.content:
After getting some feedback from the players about AI generated content, I decided to add non-AI generated images and music as well.
Now you can choose before you start the game to disable AI generated poodle images and music.
This will replace the AI poodles with real images of poodles and AI music with real human recorded music (mostly metal \m/)

What does this update include?

34 real images of poodles
34 real recoded music
11 new AI poodles
11 new AI songs
2 new achievements
Bug fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101742/5592cb99c7b42d457b1b9a70ea1fdcc4a0c9ffa4.png

You can also now, if you want to support the developer, buy the soundtrack.
Happy clicking!
